correctness.rationale: For labeled q>=2, the overlap digraph on triples is balanced after deleting exactly q² four-letter edges. Constant forbidden edges are loops, and nonconstant ones form antiparallel pairs, giving L=qI-A-DD^T. Using A³=J, the zero-sum inverse of qI-A, the K_q incidence Gram eigenvalues q (q-1 times) and 0 (remaining), and directed matrix-tree theorem yields rooted tree number q^(q³-q²+q-4)(q-1)^(2(q-1))(q²-2q+2)^((q-1)(q-2)/2). BEST with q² degree-(q-1) vertices and q³-q² degree-q vertices yields precisely the stated factorial product, cyclic edge-label normalization accounted for. For all m>=5, a prefix of 0100(1100)^∞ gives indegree q-1 and outdegree q, so no Euler tour. Orders <=3 are ordinary de Bruijn; m=4 existence from positive cofactor and balance. Independent SymPy cofactors q=2,3 produced 4 and 10,331,213,040, and exact U2=4 and U3=2708265511157760; not extrapolation.
